g.text: 42b · Trace query, latency analysis and token cost auditing
Query recent RAG traces filtered by latency > 2s or error status
Return flame-graph trace tree with component breakdown
Aggregate token consumption and cost metrics per model/endpoint
Trigger threshold alert to engineering team via Slack/PagerDuty
Display operational health status (All SLOs green)
